title.zh: 苏格拉底式追问：把文章炼成你自己的看法
title.en: Socratic Opinion Distiller for Vault Notes

pain.zh: 文章存了几百篇，「我的看法」那一栏永远是空的；如果直接叫 AI 帮写读后感，它吐出来的全是四平八稳、毫无温度的假感悟，既不是你自己的真实立场，写进文章里也完全没有辨识度。
pain.en: Hundreds of clipped articles sit in your vault with empty `## 我的看法` sections—and letting an AI ghostwrite reflections for you yields generic, soulless platitudes that aren't actually your stance.

solution.zh: 守住「绝不代笔」铁律，用苏格拉底式逐问帮你把真想法榨出来：先读原文用 1–2 句对齐骨架，再按「买不买账 / 经验检验 / 对你的意义」一次只抛一个大白话问题（带回答示例，绝不用十道题淹没你），等你回答后再忠实整理进原文的 `## 我的看法`；还能跨同主题 MOC 多篇文章把你的零散看法聚合成主题观点综述，直通成文草稿。
solution.en: Enforces a strict no-ghostwriting rule using Socratic questioning: align briefly on the article's core argument, ask ONE plain-language question at a time (with a short example, never a wall of questions), distill only your actual replies into `## 我的看法` without altering the rest of the file, or aggregate your opinions across a topic MOC into a synthesis draft ready for `compose`.

steps.title: 先对齐原文骨架
steps.desc: 读取 `## 原文` 用 1–2 句确认文章主旨，不动原摘抄也不看空壳。

steps.title: 每次只抛一个大白话问题
steps.desc: 按立场、经验与个人意义提问，附带简短回答示例，等你说完再问下一句。

steps.title: 第一人称落盘不篡改全文
steps.desc: 只整理你表达过的判断写入 `## 我的看法`，其余 frontmatter 与原文纹丝不动。

steps.title: 跨多篇聚合为主题综述
steps.desc: 读取 `_MOC/<分类>/<主题>.md` 下各篇看法，素材足够后合成观点综述草稿。

guardrails: 绝不代写或加入用户从未表达过的判断与金句
严禁一次抛出五六个问题或大表格淹没思考注意力
原文已有非占位看法时先问追加还是替换，绝不静默覆盖

steps.title: Align on source text
steps.desc: Read `## 原文` and align in 1–2 crisp sentences without modifying source text.

steps.title: Ask one question at a time
steps.desc: Probe stance, lived experience, and personal takeaway—one plain question per turn.

steps.title: Write only your words
steps.desc: Format your actual answers into `## 我的看法` while keeping all other sections intact.

steps.title: Synthesize across a MOC
steps.desc: Aggregate your notes across a topic MOC into a draft ready for `compose-article-draft`.

guardrails: Never ghostwrites opinions or adds unexpressed judgments
Never overwhelms you with multi-question surveys in a single turn
Asks append vs. replace if `## 我的看法` already has real content

title.zh: 从历史语料与审计报告提炼 20 区长期知识
title.en: Distill Long-Term Knowledge from Vault History

pain.zh: 工作台任务、冻结审计报告、项目调研和历史导入区里堆满了宝贵经验，但里面混着过时的 `status`/`owner`、个人环境路径甚至敏感信息；直接把整份报告搬进 `20_资料库` 会污染长期知识，全靠手重写又太耗时。
pain.en: Valuable insights sit trapped inside old task trackers, frozen audit logs, and historical imports—mixed with stale `status` fields, local paths, and sensitive details that shouldn't be copied raw into permanent knowledge.

solution.zh: 在绝对保留 `30/40/60/90` 原始证据不动的前提下，把经验「去状态、去敏化、查重后」提炼成干净的 `20_资料库` 长期知识（create-only 新建）：先用 `query-vault` 查重，经 `knowledge_manifest.py` 走计划与校验写进 `10_主题知识`/`20_规范与手册`/`30_学习指南`，正文必答「是什么/适用与边界/依据/如何复用/风险」，写完立刻同步全库地图与 `.base`。
solution.en: Distill stateless, reusable permanent notes into `20_资料库` (`create-only`) while leaving `30/40/60/90` evidence untouched: deduplicate via `query-vault`, strip ephemeral task status and sensitive strings, validate via `knowledge_manifest.py`, require clear source wikilinks, and immediately update the vault map and `.base`.

title.zh: 长文/论文独立 AI 解读：选读判断，绝不代写观点

pain.zh: 剪藏了一篇两万字的英文长文或论文，不确定值不值得花半小时精读；如果叫 AI 直接在原笔记里写总结，既怕它弄脏原文件、又怕它越俎代庖把「我的看法」写满。
pain.en: When deciding whether a 10,000-word paper deserves a deep read, asking an AI to summarize inside the original note risks corrupting your clip or overwriting `## 我的看法` with AI opinions.

solution.zh: 作为纯客观的「选读决策辅助层」，永远在同目录单独产出 `<原文件名>-AI解读.md` 并双链回原文，**绝对不碰原文件一字一行（更不读不改 `## 我的看法`）**：默认给「快读」五段式帮你快速判断值不值得深挖；要求「精读」时逐节核查论证链与逻辑跳跃，原文没交代的绝不脑补，老老实实标出「原文未明确/需核对」。
solution.en: Act strictly as an AI read-triage assistant by creating a separate `<stem>-AI解读.md` file linked back to the original—never reading or modifying the source file's `## 我的看法`. Supports 2–3 sentence `quick` triage or section-by-section `deep` argument verification, marking missing premises transparently instead of inventing.

title.zh: 纯本地 Obsidian 书库总览、阅读记录补建与 Base 校验
title.en: Local Book Library Catalog & Reading Record Sync

pain.zh: 书库里建了几百张书卡和七个状态的阅读记录（想读/在读/完成等），时间一长：有些书卡忘了建阅读记录、图书馆总览和按类型分馆目录过期了，或者 `.base` 视图漏写路径过滤把不相干的文件也扫进来。
pain.en: Maintaining hundreds of Obsidian book cards and 7-state reading records by hand leads to orphaned book cards, stale genre/library overviews, and misconfigured `.base` filters.

solution.zh: 100% 纯本地、幂等运行，完全不依赖微信读书或任何外部 API：自动为缺记录的书卡补建「待读」条目（已有则跳过）；一键重新生成图书馆总览、7 态阅读记录总览与按分类书库视图（支持 `--output` 先预览再写回）；最后重建全库地图并用 `vault_index_verify.py` 核验每个 `.base` 的 `file.inFolder` 根路径约束。
solution.en: 100% local, idempotent Python 3 stdlib tooling with zero network or WeRead API dependencies: backfill missing reading records safely (`backfill_reading_records.py`), regenerate library, 7-state reading, and genre overviews (`--output` preview supported), and enforce `file.inFolder(...)` `.base` integrity via `vault_index_verify.py`.

pain.zh: Obsidian 笔记存到上千篇后，最怕悄无声息坏掉：死链越来越长、不同文件夹出现同名笔记引起双链歧义、20 区/50 区编号漂移、或者 `OB知识库地图.md` 早就过时；可普通整理脚本一扫就顺手帮你改名删文件，吓得不敢跑。
pain.en: Once an Obsidian vault grows past a thousand notes, broken wikilinks, ambiguous duplicate filenames, zone numbering drift, and stale vault maps pile up—while aggressive cleanup tools risk silently renaming or deleting notes.

solution.zh: 坚守「诊断归诊断、搬家归搬家」：健康检查与周维护默认 100% 只读零写盘，用 `lint_vault.py` 一次性扫出死链（含附件与 `.base`）、同名歧义、主标签漂移、过期候选与 20/50 区编号漂移，明确分出「确定结构问题」和「待人工裁决项」；仅当你确认「重建地图」时，才先 `--output` 预览再写回地图并校验 `.base`。

Rebuilding `OB知识库地图.md` previews first via `--output` and verifies `.base` roots afterward.

title.en: Vault Lifecycle: Manifest Moves, Renames & Link Repair

pain.zh: 想把散落在收件箱或旧目录里的几百篇笔记整理归位、规范编号、把过期文档归档进 90 区：用普通 `mv` 或 `rm` 一动手，Obsidian 里的 `[[双链]]` 全断成死链，而且一旦搬错目录连怎么回滚恢复都找不到记录。
pain.en: Reorganizing hundreds of vault notes with raw `mv` or `rm` shatters Obsidian `[[wikilinks]]`, breaks zone numbering, leaves zero SHA-256 rollback trail, and risks deleting notes that still have incoming references.

solution.zh: 用严格可审计、可回滚的 manifest 流水线管理知识库全生命周期（10 工作台 / 20 资料库 / 30 冻结证据 / 90 归档）：任何搬迁、重命名或编号规范化都先生成带每文件 SHA-256 的 `plan` 清单给你确认，再无覆盖 `apply`、`verify` 并自动修复 `incoming_refs` 反向链接（有入链的空笔记自动阻断删除）；凡路径变动立刻联动重建地图并过 `vault_index_verify.py`。
solution.en: Manage 10/20/30/90 vault lifecycles through SHA-256 manifests (`vault_lifecycle.py` & `vault_structure_plan.py`): generate a file-by-file `plan` for approval first, apply without overwrites, support deterministic `rollback`, repair exact `incoming_refs` wikilinks (blocking deletion of linked notes), and verify updated maps + `.base` views.

solution.zh: 把文章整理拆成「单篇默认增量」与「批量先盘点后原子重建」两档：`clip` 新收进来的一篇文章，直接补齐摘要、`topics`、`captured_at` 并按月归位，随后跑 `rebuild_moc.py --article` 只增量刷新受影响的一/二级 MOC 与全库地图（遇到未收录的新 topic 自动停下阻断，绝不乱建野分类）；需要全库大盘点时则先 `--full-rebuild --dry-run` 给你审核后再同盘原子替换 `_MOC/`。

title.zh: 只读知识库分层检索：按权威度排序与防泄密
title.en: Read-Only Tiered Vault Search & Evidence Lookup

pain.zh: 在几千篇笔记的 Obsidian 里问一个问题，普通全文搜索按关键词命中次数排序，结果最先蹦出来的往往是 90 区已经作废的历史导入废稿，甚至把历史日志里的旧状态当成现在还在进行的工作；而且一不小心还会把扫描版 PDF 仅文件名命中当成已经读过全文。
pain.en: Plain keyword search ranks stale historical imports above current truth because they repeat a keyword more often—and mistakes PDF filename matches for verified document content.

solution.zh: 把检索做成「严格只读 + 按权威层级排序 + 附件真伪分清」的证据引擎：`query_vault.py` 支持按文件名、正文、frontmatter、标签、反向链接与目录盘点搜索；默认按 `10 工作台现态 → 20 精选稳定知识 → 30 冻结证据 → 90 历史归档` 排序（先排除 `历史导入` 噪声）；对敏感区默认启用 `--no-snippets` 防正文泄密，且严格区分 `filename_hit` 与 `content_hit`。
solution.en: A strictly read-only tiered retrieval layer (`query_vault.py`): search by filename, content, frontmatter, tag, backlinks, or folder inventory; rank results by source authority (`10 active -> 20 stable -> 30 frozen -> 90 archived`, excluding noisy legacy imports by default); protect sensitive scopes with `--no-snippets`; and distinguish `filename_hit` vs. `content_hit`.

pain.en: Turning long notes into Chinese infographics with raw image-gen models almost always blurs or garbles dense Chinese text—and crude PIL/Canvas text patches over broken bitmaps look awful.

solution.en: Default to crisp local headless-browser HTML/CSS rendering (with optional explicit `open-design` or `codex-image` backends): distill `visual_dense` structure, save reproducible prompts first, pass mechanical quality gates, and verify real PNGs (>50KB, width >=750px, zero clipped/garbled Chinese)—always re-rendering from prompt fixes rather than patching pixels.

title.zh: 外文文章三档精翻：机械分块、术语表与不改原文

pain.zh: 翻译一篇一万多字的英文长文或剪藏双语笔记时，常遇到三个头疼问题：直接喂给大模型后半段漏译偷懒；前半篇叫「代理」后半篇变成「智能体」术语乱飘；更坑的是如果原文是剪藏笔记，脚本把原本带有的英文和摘要一起算词数，导致分块错位甚至把原文件直接覆盖了。
pain.en: Translating 10,000-word foreign articles or bilingual clips often drops paragraphs mid-way, drifts terminology across chunks, miscounts already-translated sections, or overwrites the original note.

solution.zh: 提供 `quick`（快翻大意）/ `normal`（默认，带文体与术语表）/ `refined`（出版级精翻+跨块审校）三档模式，**永远另写独立新文件（绝不覆盖原文件）**：超过 4000 词自动用 `chunk_markdown.py` 机械切块（保护完整代码块不被拦腰切断），遇到 clip 归档笔记时聪明地先只截取 `## 原文` 段再切块；支持自定义术语表与「继续润色」一键升级精翻。
solution.en: Translate into a separate new file (never overwriting the source) across three modes—`quick`, `normal` (default, with style & glossary consistency), and `refined` (publication-grade cross-chunk review). Articles `>4000` words use `chunk_markdown.py` to split cleanly around code blocks, and clip notes extract only `## 原文` before chunking.
